description.value: A Tim Hortons franchise located on Tranquille Road in the north end of Kamloops, offering brewed coffee, specialty beverages, breakfast wraps, soups, and baked goods. The location features dine-in seating, a drive-through, and free Wi-Fi, making it a practical rest stop for cyclists coming in from the north or heading toward Sun Peaks. It is part of Canada's largest quick-service restaurant chain, known for reliable, affordable food and coffee across the country.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The Tim Hortons location page at the OSM-provided URL loaded successfully and confirms the address, phone number, and key features (WiFi, Take Out, Dine-In, Drive-Thru). OSM tags (internet_access=wlan, internet_access:fee=no, takeaway=yes, drive_through=yes) are all corroborated by the website. No bike parking, washroom, or water refill information appears on the website or in the OSM tags, so those fields are null.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating Tim Hortons franchise with confirmed address, phone, and active location page. A reliable food and coffee stop useful to touring cyclists.
